reviews.title: Not good price
reviews.body: Price too higher than other apps
reviews.suggested_reply: Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry the prices didn't meet your expectations — we compare many airlines to surface the best fares and are working to improve. We appreciate your input!
¡Muchas gracias por tu reseña! Nos alegra que la app te resulte clara y actualizada. ¡Gracias por tu apoyo!

reviews.title: Very reliable
reviews.body: This app can connect you to all the different airline websites to get the best price.
